physical.name: Strength
physical.description: Physical prowess, including the capacity to lift objects and cause damage. Used for jumping, lifting, and raw physical might. Determines base damage for physical attacks.

ratings.label: Poor
ratings.description: You can lift 80 lbs.

ratings.label: Average
ratings.description: You can lift 120 lbs.

ratings.label: Good
ratings.description: You can lift 250 lbs.

ratings.label: Exceptional
ratings.description: You can lift 400 lbs.

ratings.label: Outstanding
ratings.description: You can lift 650 lbs. and crush skulls like grapes.

physical.name: Dexterity
physical.description: Agility, hand-eye coordination and reflexes. Describes speed, aim precision, and physical control. Used for many skills requiring speed and flexibility.

ratings.label: Poor
ratings.description: You are clumsy and awkward.

ratings.label: Average
ratings.description: You're no clod, but don't expect to win any awards.

ratings.label: Good
ratings.description: You show some potential. Above-average.

ratings.label: Exceptional
ratings.description: You could be an acrobat if you wanted.

ratings.label: Outstanding
ratings.description: Backflips everywhere, running on walls, being awesome.

physical.name: Constitution
physical.description: Health, well-being, general toughness and resistance. Covers endurance before getting tired and starting hit points.

ratings.label: Poor
ratings.description: You bruise in a stiff wind.

ratings.label: Average
ratings.description: Moderately healthy, can withstand a punch or two.

ratings.label: Good
ratings.description: In good shape and rarely fall ill.

ratings.label: Exceptional
ratings.description: You can run in marathons—and win!

ratings.label: Outstanding
ratings.description: You almost never get sick and don't get tired.

social.name: Charisma
social.description: How innately likeable someone is. Reflects confidence, social grace, force of personality, and ability to compel others.

ratings.label: Poor
ratings.description: Stop picking your nose.

ratings.label: Average
ratings.description: Generally likable with several friends.

ratings.label: Good
ratings.description: People trust you implicitly.

ratings.label: Exceptional
ratings.description: Significant personal magnetism.

ratings.label: Outstanding
ratings.description: Entire cultures could follow your lead.

social.name: Fellowship
social.description: Appearance and ability for self-expression. The capacity to coerce, manipulate, and influence others through words and appearance.

ratings.label: Poor
ratings.description: Few words and plain face.

ratings.label: Average
ratings.description: Normal looking, not bad at talking.

ratings.label: Good
ratings.description: You never pay full price.

ratings.label: Exceptional
ratings.description: Could be a politician or cult leader.

ratings.label: Outstanding
ratings.description: People will live and die on your word.

social.name: Composure
social.description: Ability to remain calm in social and threatening situations. A measure of emotional fortitude, restraint, and calm.

ratings.label: Poor
ratings.description: You fold to peer pressure like origami paper.

ratings.label: Average
ratings.description: Once in a while you stand up for yourself.

ratings.label: Good
ratings.description: Speak your mind when needed and control yourself.

ratings.label: Exceptional
ratings.description: Others see only calm.

ratings.label: Outstanding
ratings.description: You've probably never been afraid.

mental.name: Intelligence
mental.description: Memory, understanding, reasoning and imagination. Ability to correlate information and make deductions. Also covers starting languages.

ratings.label: Poor
ratings.description: Not the sharpest knife in the drawer.

ratings.label: Average
ratings.description: Smart enough to realize you're normal.

ratings.label: Good
ratings.description: More enlightened than the masses.

ratings.label: Exceptional
ratings.description: Not just bright, you're brilliant!

ratings.label: Outstanding
ratings.description: Certified genius.

mental.notes: At 3+ dots, gain one extra spoken language per dot above 2.

mental.name: Wisdom
mental.description: Alertness and comprehension. Determines how well you notice the world and interpret what you observe.

ratings.label: Poor
ratings.description: Self-absorbed or an airhead. Details elude you.

ratings.label: Average
ratings.description: Oblivious to the subtle, but not the big picture.

ratings.label: Good
ratings.description: Read the environment like a book.

ratings.label: Exceptional
ratings.description: Almost nothing evades your notice.

ratings.label: Outstanding
ratings.description: Instantly observe things others overlook.

mental.name: Willpower
mental.description: How strongly you hold onto your ideas and resist mental commands. Used to resist supernatural effects.

ratings.label: Poor
ratings.description: A follower, not a leader.

ratings.label: Average
ratings.description: Can hold out as long as the average person.

ratings.label: Good
ratings.description: Seldom left surprised or speechless.

ratings.label: Exceptional
ratings.description: Look death in the eye and make it blink.

ratings.label: Outstanding
ratings.description: A bastion of mental power.

mental.name: Academic Lore
mental.description: Knowledge of scholarly subjects. Successful Tests enable you to recall pertinent facts and do research.

mental.name: Arcana
mental.description: Knowledge and experience with legends and lore about the supernatural. Can generally tell fact from rumor.

mental.name: Common Lore
mental.description: Recall habits, institutions, traditions, public figures, and superstitions of a particular world, culture, organization or race.

mental.name: Crafts
mental.description: Training or expertise in creating works of art or construction with your hands, from paintings to car engines.

mental.name: Forbidden Lore
mental.description: Dangerous and often illegal knowledge. Simply possessing this skill is often enough to warrant death.

mental.name: Medicae
mental.description: Used to treat injuries, closing wounds and restoring the body's balance. Vital for stabilizing allies.

mental.name: Perception
mental.description: Ability to perceive hidden dangers and notice small details about your physical surroundings.

mental.name: Politics
mental.description: Familiar with the political process, bureaucracies, and who to call to get things done.

mental.name: Tech-Use
mental.description: Allows use or repair of complex mechanical items or fathoming unknown technical artifacts.

physical.name: Acrobatics
physical.description: Movement techniques like somersaults, tumbling, flipping through the air, and daring leaps.

physical.name: Athletics
physical.description: Basic physical ability covering running, jumping, throwing, swimming, and sports.

physical.name: Ballistics
physical.description: Broad familiarity with guns and how to operate them. Requires weapon proficiency feat for practical use.

physical.name: Brawl
physical.description: Used with unarmed attacks. Covers all fighting styles—martial arts, grappling, etc.

physical.name: Drive
physical.description: Control autos, trucks, landspeeders and other land-based or hover vehicles.

physical.name: Larceny
physical.description: Palm objects, pick pockets, pick locks, conceal stolen goods, bypass security.

physical.name: Pilot
physical.description: Fly anything from small atmospheric craft to spelljamming ships.

physical.name: Stealth
physical.description: Actively hide from someone or something. Requires appropriate terrain or concealment.

physical.name: Weaponry
physical.description: Broad skill with melee weapons. Requires weapon proficiency feat for practical use.

social.name: Animal Ken
social.description: Understand animal behavior patterns. Predict reactions, train, ride, or calm animals.

social.name: Charm
social.description: Befriend others. Change minds of individuals or small groups, beg, or seduce.

social.name: Command
social.description: Make subordinates follow orders. Only usable on those under your authority.

social.name: Deceive
social.description: Lie and con others. Convince others of things not necessarily true.

social.name: Disguise
social.description: Mask features and assume another's appearance.

social.name: Intimidation
social.description: Scare people. Can use almost any characteristic depending on circumstances.

social.name: Performer
social.description: Entertain and enthrall crowds. Carry a tune, put on a show.

social.name: Persuasion
social.description: Get your point across clearly. Phrase opinions in compelling manner, skilled acting.

social.name: Scrutiny
social.description: Make assessments about people, determine if lying, sense ulterior motives.

skillNotes.basic: Can be attempted at zero dots with -1 to your characteristic.
skillNotes.advanced: Cannot be attempted without at least one dot (unless you have Jack of All Trades feat).
skillNotes.specialtyAt4: Every Skill and Characteristic gains a Specialty at 4 dots. Reroll any 1s when the specialty applies.
